questions.question: Found while proving T2: the host still proposes per-leaf 'allow for future' rules for PIPED commands (e.g. `npm test | tee file`), even though a saved leaf rule can never authorise a pipe (decision 0134). For a job that means Allow would save useless rules and the job asks again every run; in chat it offers an 'Allow for future' that never works. Fix at the source?
options: Yes — never propose leaf rules for a piped command (Recommended)
No — only classify pipes as 'once' on job cards
questions.chosen: Yes — never propose leaf rules for a piped command (Recommended)
